title: Quietly Resinous Portuguese Fish Tagine
description: A light and pillowy Portuguese dish featuring tamarind paste and shio-koji-cure, prepared in a ceramic tagine, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a quiet dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the tamarind paste and shio-koji.
Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the tagine and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cod fillets to the tagine and spoon some of the onion mixture over them.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish the dish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
